links.outcome: MLLM diagnostic accuracy compared against retinal specialists on same cases
links.effect: Human specialists' accuracy 0.571-0.714 (broad list) and 0.804-0.839 (limited list) vs best MLLM 0.298 and 0.561; MLLMs performed poorly versus specialists.
links.quote: However currently, in rare diseases such as the maculopathies studied in the present paper, MLLMs perform poorly when compared to retinal specialists, and their use is unlikely to aid clinical assessment.

links.outcome: MLLM diagnostic accuracy on intended-use rare maculopathy imaging versus expectations of clinical competence
links.effect: With a broad differential and all modalities, best accuracy was 0.351 (ChatGPT); with 3 choices and demographics, best was 0.561; staging accuracy was low (e.g., 6.3-22.9% for Stargardt).
links.quote: Together, these results demonstrated that clinical diagnostic performance was poor when MLLMs were given many choices.

links.outcome: Sensitivity of MLLM performance to input variation (answer choices, demographic info, imaging modality)
links.effect: Accuracy rose when answer choices were limited (e.g., ChatGPT 1D 0.351 to 3D 0.421 to 4D 0.561); adding demographics reduced accuracy in most models from 1D to 2D.
links.quote: When all three imaging modalities were prompted together, accuracy reduced from Prompt 1D to 2D in all MLLMs except for Perplexity (Table 1 ).

links.outcome: Effect of demographic data on human specialists' and MLLM performance in intended-use mode
links.effect: Human specialists' accuracy improved from 0.571-0.714 to 0.804-0.839 with limited choices; MLLMs improved but stayed lower. No human+AI assisted comparison was done.
links.quote: Human retinal specialists consistently outperformed MLLMs in diagnostic accuracy for Prompts 1 and 2, which corresponded to MLLM Prompts 2D and 4D, respectively.

links.effect: With all imaging and broad choices, best model was ChatGPT: accuracy 0.351 (0.25, 0.45), sensitivity 0.267 (0.211, 0.319).
links.quote: ChatGPT demonstrated the highest overall accuracy [0.351 (0.25, 0.45)] and the highest mean sensitivity [0.267 (0.211, 0.319)].

links.effect: Broad differential ChatGPT 1D→2D decreased 0.351→0.298; limited choices 3D→4D improved 0.421→0.561.
links.quote: The findings from this study demonstrate that MLLMs offer varying degrees of diagnostic accuracy which also varies by imaging modality and the inclusion of patient demographic information.
